narration.text: Why one man survived 2,000 sieverts to the head.
In 1978, a proton beam passed through his skull.
Anatoli Bugorski was checking faulty equipment.
The dose along its path was 2,000 to 3,000 sieverts.
Because it was so narrow, most of his body was spared.
So where radiation lands matters as much as how much.
